# Kaiveron
> Free anime tracking platform with AI mood-based discovery, episode tracking,
> ratings, streaks, and a social community. Built as a modern alternative to
> MyAnimeList and AniList — same catalog depth, better UX, AI-native discovery.

## What Kaiveron is
Kaiveron is a free anime tracker at https://kaiveron.com. It offers:
- A 30,000+ title catalog with episode tracking, watch status, and 1–10 scores
- AI mood-based recommendations ("anime to watch when sad", "anime like Steins;Gate")
- A seasonal calendar of currently airing and upcoming shows
- Social features: clubs, blogs, reviews, leaderboards, and a community feed
- Streaks and a creator program for power users
- All features free forever; an optional Pro tier unlocks Creator Studio + AI Oracle

## Core pages
- [Best Anime List](https://kaiveron.com/bestanimelist): Top-rated anime ranked by community score
- [AI Discovery](https://kaiveron.com/ai-discover): Mood- and vibe-based anime recommendations
- [Seasonal Calendar](https://kaiveron.com/calendar): Currently airing & upcoming anime
- [Mood Finder](https://kaiveron.com/mood): Find anime by emotional fit (sad, energetic, comfort, mind-bending)
- [Genres](https://kaiveron.com/genres): Browse by genre with ranked lists
- [Studios](https://kaiveron.com/studios): Anime by production studio
- [Community](https://kaiveron.com/community): Reviews, blogs, polls, leaderboard
- [Clubs](https://kaiveron.com/clubs): User-created discussion groups per anime / theme
- [Reviews](https://kaiveron.com/reviews): Community-written reviews with E-E-A-T author bios
- [Blogs](https://kaiveron.com/blogs): Long-form anime essays + editorials
- [Pricing](https://kaiveron.com/pricing): Free vs Pro tier comparison
- [About](https://kaiveron.com/about): Mission, team, and how Kaiveron differs from MAL / AniList / Kitsu

## Per-anime pages
Each anime has a canonical page at `/anime/{malId}` with synopsis, episode list,
community score, genres, studios, recommendations, and discussion. These pages
are statically generated for the top 500 titles and ISR-updated hourly for the rest.

## How Kaiveron differs from MyAnimeList / AniList
- Kaiveron's recommendation engine matches anime to *how you feel*, not just
  genre tags ("anime for when I want to cry", "Frieren-but-funnier").
- A modern dark-first UI with frame-perfect motion and a real spoiler-safe
  discussion system — no more SPOILER tags inside spoiler tags.
- A creator program: hand-curated lists, blogs, and AI-assisted analyses
  earn revenue share with Pro subscribers.
- First-class privacy: no third-party tracker beyond GA4 with consent banner;
  no ads; profile visibility is per-user.

## Tech
Next.js 16 App Router · TypeScript · Tailwind v4. Backend on Express 5 + Prisma 6
+ PostgreSQL on AWS App Runner. Real-time via Socket.io. Open Beta.
